firstScreen.notes: 1440-first.jpg: full-width 2-line h1 with trade+city+outcome, ticket with real fields and Sample pricing, ochre Price it + outlined call, facts band now peeks. 390-first.jpg: both actions above fold, sticky bar. Header Price it is teal vs hero ochre.

distinctiveness.notes: Ticket system in 7 sections plus drawdown-divider-with-roller on every band (1440-scroll-25.jpg, 1440-scroll-75.jpg); hero no longer mirrors painter-A. Services 3x3 and reviews 3x2 card grids repeat a template shape (1440-rm-full.jpg, -0.5).

type.notes: Gallon formula 381 x 2 / 350 = 2.2 is a real tabular display moment (1440-rm-full.jpg); en dashes fixed. Mono caps label density still high in hero ticket (1440-first.jpg) and footer (1440-rm-full.jpg, -0.5).

layout.notes: ZIP and sheen bands now use the width (1440-rm-full.jpg). Gallon band left column leaves ~250px dead teal, and test-card band at rest is a mostly empty striped panel (1440-rm-full.jpg y~2350 and y~6600, -0.5).

photo.notes: All drawn and consistent: siding layer stack (1440-scroll-50.jpg), sheen steps now demonstrate sheen (1440-rm-full.jpg). Hero swatch is a flat ochre block (1440-first.jpg).

copy.notes: Trade nouns and honest hedges ('exact number comes after we see the walls', 1440-scroll-25.jpg); Sample labels on reviews, rating, price, licence (1440-scroll-75.jpg). Review quote used as section h2 (1440-rm-full.jpg DD-05).

mobile.notes: 390-full.jpg: recomposed stacks, wrapped sheen tabs, single-column form, sticky bar; no overflow at 320/390 per render.json.

a11y.notes: 1440-rm-full.jpg and 390-rm-full.jpg show every section and word; no console errors in render.json; form states nothing is sent.

motion.notes: Drawdown pull with roller across band edges and test card mid-pull (1440-scroll-25.jpg); scrubbed prep layer build with progress rule (1440-scroll-50.jpg). No visible hero moment in 1440-first.jpg.

wow.notes: Scope ticket (1440-scroll-25.jpg) and gallon formula ticket with Buy 3 gallons (1440-rm-full.jpg) are keepable artifacts; the tools are not chained into one ticket.

polish.notes: Sheen tabs now square, designed footer ticket (1440-rm-full.jpg). Header CTA teal vs hero CTA ochre in 1440-first.jpg (-0.5).

elevate.move: Make numbers the type system: every ticket's key figure (2.0 gal, price range, 2.2, ZIP count) set in one Antonio tabular display tier with Karla units, mono caps cut to a single small field-name tier so the page reads as a printed lab sheet.

Chain the tools into one document: the gallon result writes onto the scope ticket, which writes onto the request ticket, so each band visibly hands its ticket down the page and the card-grid stretches gain a narrative order.
